scope: Read-only own-source LSE GPIO-pad ownership audit, 13 families, 37 current catalog selectors; R031/W031 MCU only, RF excluded
baseline: Stage40 current source, delivered Stage39 per parent; no candidate changes

families.enable_read_semantics: RW software enable, 0 disabled/1 enabled; not STABLE; no read side effect documented
families.automatic_request: No hidden automatic LSE enable/request is documented in own RCC/RTC sections; manual requires software LSEEN and RTC pre-enable/start. Do not transpose LSI hidden-request behavior.
families.configuration_lock: LSELOCK prevents clearing LSEEN, not a documented lock on MODE or all LSE parameters. Active parameter changes are prohibited by oscillator procedure.
